name: Clear Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: finely chopped lean raw beef
ingredients.originalText: Two pounds of finely chopped lean raw beef

ingredients.name: The white and shell of an egg, well beaten, with a little cold water
ingredients.originalText: The white and shell of an egg, well beaten, with a little cold water

instructions.text: Heat a heaping tablespoonful of butter in a covered saucepan
Slice into it a medium-sized onion; stir until the onion is browned
Add two pounds of finely chopped lean raw beef, one quart cold water; cover closely and let it simmer three hours
Strain the soup, return to the kettle
Add the white and shell of an egg, well beaten, with a little cold water; add also four peppercorns, teaspoonful of salt, two cloves and a blade of mace
Boil five minutes, then drain and serve from a hot tureen

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat a heaping tablespoonful of butter in a covered saucepan
2. Slice into it a medium-sized onion; stir until the onion is browned
3. Add two pounds of finely chopped lean raw beef, one quart cold water; cover closely and let it simmer three hours
4. Strain the soup, return to the kettle
5. Add the white and shell of an egg, well beaten, with a little cold water; add also four peppercorns, teaspoonful of salt, two cloves and a blade of mace
6. Boil five minutes, then drain and serve from a hot tureen
